scope: Local gameplay incorrectly covered by an inert hosted-lobby overlay
cause: The global Hud layout painted static lobby content on template_map, while its script returned with pointer input disabled. Hiding the host context panel alone did not hide the content reliably.

repair.default: Transparent noninteractive host; all lobby content is inside a separate XML/CSS default-collapsed child.
repair.activation: Exact ws4_lobby or maps/ws4_lobby.vpk, after all required layout panels exist.
repair.lifecycle: Scheduled map checks and guarded actions/events deactivate the overlay on other maps. Generation guards discard callbacks from previous mounts.
repair.unchanged: Authentication, invite and typed-connect restrictions; hosted-lobby and session-multiplayer enable flags remain disabled.

automated.native_resource_compile: PASS: lobby XML, CSS and JS; 3 compiled, 0 failed

observed: N1 gameplay is visible without the hosted-lobby overlay.
Physical click on the Archive label opens the archive window.
Physical click on the Map Level category changes the displayed archive category.
Physical click on the close button closes the archive window and returns to gameplay.
native_local_verification.scope_limit: This verifies ordinary local gameplay visibility and menu input. It does not verify a native ws4_lobby session, worker allocation, remote multiplayer, cloud authentication or purchase flows.
